title: Change of control plus uncapped liability

pages.text:
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT

Between Orchard Supply and Pinecrest Goods.

Section 5. Change of Control. If Pinecrest undergoes a change of control, Orchard may end this agreement immediately upon written notice.

Signature: Riley Chen, Orchard.

Section 12. Liability. Pinecrest's liability shall be unlimited for product safety claims arising under this agreement.

Signature: Avery Stone, Pinecrest.

evidence.quote: If Pinecrest undergoes a change of control, Orchard may end this agreement immediately upon written notice.
Pinecrest's liability shall be unlimited for product safety claims arising under this agreement.

expected.rationale: Two independent risks on different pages: a termination-on-control-change clause and unlimited product-safety liability. Both parties signed, so no signature finding.
